planning_notes: The request for 5 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the 7 available. To ensure high difficulty and non-redundancy, each target was assigned a unique, high-order cognitive facet (Error Diagnosis, Boundary Edge Case, Theoretical Rationale, Output Prediction, and Off-by-One Analysis). This approach avoids simple recall and forces students to apply deep logical reasoning, trace complex state changes, and identify subtle invariant violations in the Binary Search Partitioning strategy.
